comment: Solr's schema-fields handler reports a field's type as a literal string: 'int', 'pint', 'long', 'string', ... This fixture pins two int-shaped fields so a parser that maps every field to str is caught. §13 owns the Solr family this belongs to; the exact type vocabulary is Solr's, which is why it is recorded here rather than in the spec.
